bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap of the across-fly mean

publishedComparison.note: Published aggregate curves retained separately; not substituted for the 17-fly secondary analysis. Author plotting code applies additional selection, including trial-count criteria.

method.population: 17 male Canton-S flies; study used 2–6-day-old males, raised at 18 C. Freely walking arena, 60 Hz tracking and green projector (~520 nm). Different specimens from MaleCNS and FlyBody.
method.preprocessing: All 1519 deposited sheet-1e trials. Per-trial mean over frames 0–119 subtracted; average trials within each fly and condition, then equally weight 17 flies. Frames 0–419 retained, onset at 120, 60 Hz. No additional smoothing or selection.
method.sign: Positive means turning with the source-normalized stimulus direction; negative means against it. Absolute clockwise/counterclockwise identity is not retained here.
method.prediction: For each held-out fly, condition-mean baseline averages the other 16 flies. Additive full-field hypothesis sums their front-to-back and back-to-front means. Target is mean angular speed during 0 to <5 s, in degrees/s.
method.limits: Post-hoc secondary analysis within one deposited dataset. No prospective validation, neural model or prediction of an arbitrary individual. CI concerns the sample mean, not individual outcomes. Stimulus speeds/contrasts and full trial-level provenance are not exposed by this figure table; no continuous tuning controls or exact arena reenactment are claimed.
method.timingReason: Author plot functions label frame positions divided by 60 and use start=180, axvline=120 for the 7 s cropped view. Endpoint omitted to align 420 samples with published aggregate curves.
